title: How Much Does Design Cost? Logos, Book Covers and More
h1: How much does design cost? Logos, book covers, presentations and more
description: Typical starting prices for logo, book cover, presentation, packaging and landing page design from the sellers we feature, and what makes the final price go up.
intro: Design prices online range from a few dollars to several thousand, which makes it hard to know what is reasonable. This article uses the starting prices of the sellers we feature, most of them Pro-vetted, to show where the middle of the market sits for common design jobs and what pushes a project above the starting price.

faq.q: Is a very cheap logo a bad sign?
faq.a: Not always, but very low prices often mean limited revisions, stock elements or missing source files. Check the package list before deciding.

faq.q: Why do prices differ so much between sellers?
faq.a: Experience, verification level, delivery time, number of concepts, revisions and which files you receive all change the price.

faq.q: Does the starting price include everything I need?
faq.a: Usually not. The smallest package often covers one concept and basic files. Source files, extra concepts and print-ready versions are commonly in larger packages.

faq.q: Should I pay more for a Pro-vetted designer?
faq.a: It can reduce risk because the seller has been screened, but you should still read the reviews and the package details.

faq.q: How can I keep the cost down?
faq.a: Write a clear brief, collect examples you like, and ask only for the files you will actually use.
